name: Proxmox_VE_GuestPerformance
description: CPU, memory, network and disk throughput for every QEMU virtual machine and LXC container in a Proxmox VE cluster, collected cluster-wide in a single API call.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript: one /cluster/resources?type=vm call per interval, whether the cluster has 10 guests or 5000.

Instance IDs are the Proxmox resource id (qemu/<vmid>, lxc/<vmid>), which is cluster-unique and unchanged by live migration or HA failover, so instances and their history survive a guest moving between nodes.

DataRateRx, DataRateTx, DiskReadRate and DiskWriteRate are declared as derive because Proxmox reports these as counters accumulated since guest start; a minimum of 0 discards the negative delta produced when a guest restarts.

DiskUsedBytes and DiskUsagePercent are reported for LXC containers only. QEMU exposes no used-disk figure -- real usage inside a VM requires the guest agent, exactly as VMware requires VMware Tools -- so those datapoints are deliberately left as no-data for VMs rather than reported as zero.

Templates are excluded from discovery: they are never running and would otherwise appear as permanently down instances.

datapoints.name: CPUUsagePercent
datapoints.description: Guest CPU utilisation, percent of its allocated cores.

datapoints.name: MemoryCapacityBytes
datapoints.description: Memory allocated to the guest, bytes.

datapoints.name: DiskUsedBytes
datapoints.description: Root disk used, bytes. LXC containers only; QEMU reports no used-disk figure.

datapoints.name: DiskUsagePercent
datapoints.description: Root disk utilisation, percent. LXC containers only.

datapoints.name: DiskReadRate
datapoints.description: Bytes read from block devices per second.

datapoints.name: DiskWriteRate
datapoints.description: Bytes written to block devices per second.
